evidence_category: Formalized integration-by-parts theorem and conditional classical-to-weak implication for the actual scaled KS operator
exact_operator: On NuclearKSSpace i = KSSpace × SpectatorConfiguration i with ordinary product Lebesgue volume, ksScaledPrincipal i c u = sum over four KS basis directions of second derivatives of u plus c*norm(y)^2 times the spectator-basis second-derivative sum. ksScaledRealPrincipal uses the identical real-valued expression.
exact_results: For every real c and smooth compactly supported real test phi, if u is smooth at every point of tsupport phi, both integrands (ksScaledRealPrincipal i c phi)*u and phi*(ksScaledPrincipal i c u) are integrable, and their integrals agree.
If additionally the real coefficient B is smooth on tsupport phi and ksScaledPrincipal i c u = B*u pointwise there, then (splitGrushin c spectatorBasis B phi)*u is integrable and has integral zero.
At c=4 both scaled definitions agree definitionally with the preserved nuclear principal definitions.

proof_review.input_locality: Only smoothness on the compact topological test support is needed; no global integrability or global smoothness of u or B is assumed.
proof_review.integrability: Existing local second-test and weighted spectator integrability theorems are summed over finite bases. Multiplication by the real constant c preserves integrability, including c=0 and negative c.
proof_review.integration_by_parts: The actual weight norm(y)^2 has no spectator derivatives. Existing twofold spectator integration by parts and ordinary KS-direction integration by parts are combined linearly with coefficient c.
proof_review.signs: splitGrushin c spectatorBasis B phi = -ksScaledRealPrincipal i c phi + B*phi. The assumed positive principal identity is therefore exactly what yields the zero weak kernel integral.
proof_review.conditional_boundary: The physical pair KS pullback identity and smoothness assumptions are not discharged here. The kernel result explicitly assumes its local classical equation; it must not be reported as the actual pair Coulomb weak equation until the parent composition supplies that equation and removes the KS singular set.
proof_review.definitions: The audited type aliases denote actual finite-dimensional KS and spectator spaces and product Lebesgue measure. The norm and fderiv expressions are unchanged except for the explicitly supplied real spectator coefficient.

compile_policy: Three sequential check_module_v2.py builds followed by one joint audit_final_statements_v3.py run; no concurrent compiler under this agent.
